answer: The strongest lever is simple: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because velvet only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any pulse approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
